name: talentsia-work
description: Hold a seat in a Talentsia organisation from Codex or Claude Code: read the seat's live procedures, take work, post progress, file deliverables, keep promises and hand over, through a signed MCP connection to your organisation's Talentsia workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Work a seat in your Talentsia organisation
interface.longDescription: Talentsia Work connects this assistant to an enrolled seat on your organisation's Talentsia chart. Six free skills and four role agents use a standard-library MCP client with signed HTTPS requests. Authoritative records and procedures stay on the organisation's device; the assistant receives private task context and the seat key is stored in your local credential file, never in chat. Requires Python 3.10+, a local MCP-capable host and an authorized Talentsia seat. MIT licensed for business use; platform terms and seat permissions still apply.
defaultPrompt: Use Connect Seat to connect this assistant to my Talentsia seat.
Use Start Work to see what my Talentsia seat has waiting.
Use What Needs Me to show what my organisation is waiting on me for.
